evidence.observation: 6.5 ppm at growth start, matching the ramp baseline of about 4-8 ppm
Rose every reading: 12.3, 16.2, 19.5, 25.7 ppm, roughly 4x the baseline and still climbing
Holding 750 °C with steady heater power, so the thermocouple and heater look normal
Argon flow steady at about 100 sccm, so a stuck MFC is unlikely
No pressure gauge installed, so the atmosphere can't be fully checked

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure reading or a manual leak check and exhaust-line check, to tell a seal leak from an exhaust blockage; normal-run reference values for O2 during growth.
